label: HYPERLIQUID_NATIVE_C14_BROAD_UNIVERSE_POWER_ESCALATION
provenance_caveat: Real Hyperliquid-native, node-derived (Ironflow HF, CC BY 4.0), NOT venue candleSnapshot. Real fetched/archived candles, non-synthetic. 283d window 2025-12-20T00:00:00Z–2026-09-28T23:00:00Z. Performance evidence only when produced by the full decision-grade battery under this prereg.

hypothesis.description: Broad-universe Hyperliquid-native (Ironflow) power escalation of the spec crash-rebound strategy to raise effective independent crash episodes toward the decision floor, evaluated with dependence-aware inference.
hypothesis.selection_rule: Fixed by this prereg; no config switching after results.

inference_plan.power: Minimum floor: 100 permutation draws and 100 placebo subsets. GO requires >=10 trades, >=5 episodes, >=5 distinct crash days, bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0, permutation p<0.05, placebo p_ge_canonical<0.05, and spot leg > 0. If unmet, verdict must be UNDERPOWERED or NO_GO with a quantified power curve.

decision_rules.go: GO only if all hold: episode-block bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0 (spot or total with positive spot), permutation p < 0.05, placebo p_ge_canonical < 0.05, and effective N >= 10 trades / 5 episodes / 5 crash days.
no_go: CI95 spans 0 for spot and total
positive total entirely hedge/rebound-masked with non-positive spot
census/funnel shows no reproducible edge on widened universe
underpowered: Effective sample below floor; label UNDERPOWERED/FRAGILE_NOT_DECISION_GRADE
